review.why: Creates and edits spreadsheets with openpyxl and pandas, requires live formulas and a recalculation check for errors.
review.summary: Picks an approach per task, then sets rules for every output: professional font, zero formula errors, formulas rather than hardcoded results, documented assumptions and an existing file's conventions respected. A mandatory recalculation script reports errors as JSON. It lists functions that survive verification, many library gotchas and financial-model color and number conventions.
strengths: States that a clean recalculation proves formulas evaluate, not that they are right
Long list of openpyxl traps, such as destructive data-only saves and lost macros
Financial model conventions for inputs, links and number formats
cautions: Bundled recalculation script and validators are not read here
Bans newer Excel functions that its runtime cannot evaluate
